messages:
incident-bot: paging mike_oncall: detected elevated error-rate on /v1/generate canary (us-west-2). alert level: P1. auto-rollback attempted but failed to reach 50% of canary traffic.
deploy-bot: canary deploy id=c-20260315-33 started at commit 9f3b2a. traffic shifted to canary 10% -> 40% over 3m. observed latency spike at 18:42 UTC.
mike_oncall: looking. Can someone confirm whether this is affecting hosted API customers or only internal smoke tests?
carla_eng: I'm seeing 502s in the canary logs, same stacktrace referencing kv-cache.hv eviction path. past deploys had a related fix but not sure if it landed in this build.
jen_sre: metric link: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/18435 - errors/sec from canary hosts from 2 -> 18 in 2m, p95 latency 400ms -> 2.1s. customer-facing errors rising.
ben_prod: flagged by monitoring: top customer sessions with errors include a few paying customers on us-west. I opened a support stub.
mike_oncall: ok this is customer impacting. Did the automated rollback kick in? incident-bot: automated rollback policy evaluated: failure -> attempted to rollback to previous variant; rollback job failed on 2/3 canary nodes due to lingering process lock.
carl a_eng: typo? (carla_eng) yes confirming: `processctl` left stale locks during warmup, upstream fix required.
mike_oncall: we need fast mitigation. Options: continue rollback effort or cut traffic back to baseline variant (kill-switch) via feature-flag route. Any objections?
jen_sre: safe route: flip the traffic-route kill-switch to pin to stable model-variant v2.6. Risk: brief 200ms blip on the routing layer. Benefit: immediate customer impact reduction.
carla_eng: I can flip the feature flag. preparing command.
mike_oncall: @carla_eng do it and confirm. Also capture commands you run.
carla_eng: running: ```cli redwood flag set-route canary=false --scope=us-west-2 --force true```
carla_eng: flipped flag at 18:47:14 UTC.
deploy-bot: feature flag change detected: canary routing disabled by carla_eng at 18:47:14.
jen_sre: graphs: errors/sec dropping now 18 -> 4 within 30s, p95 back to ~230ms. customers appear to recover.
ben_prod: support update: notifying affected customers A & B that we rolled back traffic and are investigating root cause.
mike_oncall: good. Next: manual rollback to previous artifact or hotfix? automated rollback failed; we should avoid re-triggering until locks are fixed. Proposal: keep canary disabled for now, promote hotfix branch after fix.
carla_eng: I have a hotfix branch that removes the lock path; need a quick build & sanity test. ETA 22m for build + smoke tests.
jen_sre: meanwhile we'll monitor error budgets and check for any DB impact. Also adding a short-lived alert to pages if errors > 5/s for 5m.
incident-bot: note recorded: mitigation = feature-flag kill-switch applied; automated rollback attempted and failed due to process lock; manual hotfix in progress.
mike_oncall: @carla_eng when you push the hotfix, don't auto-rollout; I'll coordinate a manual canary once you confirm fixed.
carla_eng: pushing patch to ci now. build kicked off: https://ci.redwood/builds/79012. smoke tests queued.
jen_sre: reminder: collect canary logs (hostnames r-12*, r-13*) and attach to this thread for RCA. Also snapshot the KV cache metrics: `kv.evictions`, `kv.load_latency`.
ben_prod: I've flagged billing impact assessment: rough estimate 2 minutes of elevated errors affecting 3 paying customers; finance notified for possible credits.
mike_oncall: thanks. Handing off to jen_sre for ongoing monitoring and RCA tracking. I'm going to log incident summary and start a follow-up ticket: INC-2026-0315.
jen_sre: taking handoff. I'll confirm when hotfix build passes and coordinate manual canary test.
carla_eng: build passed unit + smoke tests at 18:59:02. preparing canary image push but will hold until manual go-ahead.
mike_oncall: noted. final quick checklist: 1) ensure locks cleared on existing canary nodes 2) push hotfix image 3) manual 10% canary for 5m with synthetic probe 4) if stable -> ramp to 40% then full.
jen_sre: copying checklist into ticket. Also adding postmortem owner: carla_eng.
carla_eng: ack. will run a cleanup command on canary nodes before new deploy: ```ssh r-12* 'sudo systemctl stop redwood-runtime && sudo rm /var/run/kv.lock && sudo systemctl start redwood-runtime'```
ben_prod: support message drafted: "We've routed traffic back to the stable model variant; investigating a canary regression causing transient 5xx errors. We'll follow up with an RCA and any customer credits if applicable."
mike_oncall: closing active page. Jen, continue monitoring and reopen if errors resurge. I'll add a short incident note in the channel. :thumbsup: 
incident-bot: incident closed by mike_oncall at 19:02:45 UTC, duration 15m. mitigation: feature-flag kill-switch. follow-up ticket: INC-2026-0315.
jen_sre: logging artifacts now and will attach links to ticket. thanks everyone.
carla_eng: will start the manual canary tomorrow morning PST and update channel.
ben_prod: adding final customer comms timeline into the ticket.
